nodes.summary: Adding a trial with probability `a` raises the upper tail by exactly `a P(S = k)`: `P(S' ≥ k + 1) = P(S ≥ k + 1) + a P(S = k)`. So the tail is affine in each trial's probability, with nonnegative slope a point mass of the remaining trials.
nodes.title: Poisson-binomial tail after adding a trial

nodes.summary: Peeling off the lowest term of the tail: `P(S ≥ k) = P(S = k) + P(S ≥ k + 1)`.
nodes.title: Peeling off the lowest term of the Poisson-binomial tail

nodes.summary: If `p i ≤ q i` for all `i`, with all probabilities in `[0, 1]`, then `P_p(S ≥ k) ≤ P_q(S ≥ k)`.
nodes.title: The burden-test p-value is monotone in every background rate

nodes.summary: Upper tail `P(S ≥ k) = ∑_{k ≤ j ≤ m} P(S = j)` of the Poisson-binomial law (the mass function vanishes above `m`).
nodes.title: Upper tail of the Poisson-binomial law

nodes.summary: The Poisson-binomial masses sum to one (an identity for all real `p`; it is the expansion of `∏ ((1 - p i) + p i) = 1`).
nodes.title: Poisson-binomial masses sum to one

nodes.summary: For probabilities `p i ∈ [0, 1]` and `λ = ∑ p i`, every partial sum of `∑_j |P(S = j) - e^{-λ} λ^j / j!|` is at most `2 ∑ (p i)²`.
nodes.title: Le Cam's inequality, finite truncations

nodes.summary: Le Cam's inequality (Le Cam 1960): the series `∑_j |P(S = j) - e^{-λ} λ^j / j!|` is summable and its sum is at most `2 ∑ (p i)²`, where `λ = ∑ p i`.
nodes.title: Le Cam's inequality

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
